items.title: Update 0.4.0.201
items.summary: Muzzle flash hiders work again. Large anomaly zones return to Isolated Raids on Ozernoe, Factory, Shegolskoe and Airport. Flowermen dash more often. RPG-7 nerfed. PKM can chamber a round. Cargo Port's Abnormal Signal zone moved off the road.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.199
items.summary: Gear preset fixes, better lighting in dark areas and at night, pistol recoil restored, item-collection contract fixes.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.196
items.summary: Weapon flashlight and laser can be toggled separately again (both on L by default).

items.title: Updates 0.4.0.192
items.summary: Controls overhaul with new aim settings, less camera sway, sharper sound positioning. Magazines no longer drop on reload. Small monster habitats now use summoning rifts instead of respawning.

items.title: Active Matter: Activity Report
items.summary: First-month recap: more than ten updates and hundreds of changes since the Steam and console launch.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.182
items.summary: Guts and Ghost Body Sleeves reworked, faster magazine handling, KB+M on consoles, armor resists melee better, M82A1 hits harder, big medkits buffed.

items.title: A Beginner Operative's Guide
items.summary: Official illustrated briefing for new players.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.173
items.summary: More cover at Headquarters, Airport and Downtown exits. Contract locations easier to find. Molotovs and incendiaries ignite instantly.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.163
items.summary: Dalniy Island exits relocated with new cover, Seeds give up chases sooner, no rooftop Hellhounds, Distorted pursuit tuned.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.156
items.summary: Some property now carries over when you collapse a Personal Timeline. Bigger rewards for dangerous anomalies, reworked fusion UI.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.132
items.summary: Loot added to Ural truck cargo. Tougher Distorted in marked threat zones. Level 2–5 rewards no longer edition-locked.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.122
items.summary: Dynamic extraction points in Dogorsk. New scream-summoning Distorted variant in lairs.
